lessons.correction: Increase your economy and production to match the opponent's heavy economy, while continuing technology development.
lessons.mistake: Focusing on technology and economy while neglecting army production, leaving you vulnerable to an attack.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you see enemy units or when your own production and technology become more defined.
lessons.title: Match Opponent's Economy
lessons.when: Early game when opponent has heavy economy and technology, moderate production, and your own economy is moderate with heavy technology.
lessons.why: The opponent's heavy economy and technology indicate a macro-oriented game; matching their economy and production keeps you competitive.

lessons.correction: Strengthen your ground forces further, considering adding Siege Tanks or Marauders to counter Zealots and Stalkers.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting upgrades or tech that could give the opponent an advantage in the ground engagement.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you see more of the opponent's army composition or when you are ready to push.
lessons.title: Counter Ground Composition
lessons.when: Late-midgame when both sides have ground posture, opponent has Zealots and Stalkers with heavy economy, production, and technology, and your ground forces include Marines, Reapers, and Widow Mines.
lessons.why: The opponent's ground army is strong; Siege Tanks provide area denial and Marauders are effective against Zealots.

lessons.correction: Strengthen your ground forces, considering adding Marauders to counter Zealots and Sentries.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to a single unit composition that could be countered by Sentry abilities.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you see more of the opponent's army composition or when you are ready to push.
lessons.title: Adapt to Sentry Threats
lessons.when: Early-midgame when opponent has ground posture with Zealots and Sentries, heavy economy, production, and technology, and your ground forces include Marines.
lessons.why: The opponent's ground army is strong; Marauders are effective against Zealots and can help break Sentry force fields.
